name: DGrid
description: Free router model that schedules across free compute and bills $0 per token.
overview: DGrid publishes a single router model, dgridai/free, priced at $0 per million input and output tokens. It schedules across whatever free capacity it has — general chat, reasoning, coding help, multilingual writing — so you call one model ID through POST /v1/chat/completions at https://api.dgrid.ai/v1 and get whichever upstream is healthy, rather than choosing a model yourself. A free API key is all that is needed.

privacy.label: Aggregated free compute, check per model

notes: The backing model is chosen at request time, so throughput and capability vary.

models.name: Free Models Router
models.rate_limits: Free router; capacity shared across free upstreams
